comments.text:
Probably best policy today, for maternity, is a combo of base & super top-up plan.

Base plan: Bajaj My Health Care is good with maternity + new born benefits (2yr Maternity waiting; Maternity Limit: upto 75000/-; New Born Limit: upto 10Lakh). You may choose any other plan as well.

Super Top-Up: Bajaj Extra Care Plus is probably the only Super Top Up available today with maternity benefit (1yr Maternity waiting; 2Lakh Deductible; Maternity: Upto SI).

During claim:
first 75000/- by Base Plan. 
Next 1,25,000/- by own pocket.
Rest of the amount by Super Top-up.
